meta.title: DooDesch Support - Report a bug
meta.description: Report bugs and feedback for DooDesch's projects. Share only what you want - every hint helps.

header.title: Report a bug & share feedback
header.subtitle: Pick a project and describe what you noticed. Only a short title is required - everything else is optional. Even the smallest hint helps.

hero.title: Help with <accent>DooDesch</accent> mods
hero.subtitle: Found a bug, got a question or an idea? Discord is the fastest way - or create a ticket right here.

discord.title: Join the Discord
discord.description: Ask in the support channel. The community and I read along and usually answer the same day.

ticket.title: Create a ticket
ticket.description: Only a short title is required. Your report lands directly on my desk as a GitHub issue.

home.formSubtitle: Pick a project and describe what you noticed. Only a short title is required - every hint helps.

form.repoNoneHint: No matching project? No problem - we'll categorize it ourselves.
form.anonHint: No GitHub account needed - we file the report for you.
form.githubHint: With your GitHub account - you get notified on replies.
form.githubOpened: GitHub opened in a new tab - click "Submit new issue" there.
form.githubFallback: No tab opened? Open on GitHub.
